places.name: Psiri (Psyrri)
places.background: A former craftsmen's quarter next to Monastiraki, now packed with tavernas, bars, street art and late-night music. It is fairly alternative and gritty-bohemian (but busy with visitors), with no poshness at all.

photos.credit: Photo: Badseed · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Pavlos1988 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Monastiraki
places.background: The busy square, metro hub and flea market below the Acropolis, full of souvenir and vintage stalls and rooftop bars with views. Lively and mainstream-touristy, with a slightly scruffy edge. Not posh.

photos.credit: Photo: C messier · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Antonio Fajardo López · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Badseed · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: George E. Koronaios · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Ta Karamanlidika tou Fani
places.what_it_is: Deli/charcuterie shop with a busy meze restaurant attached: pastirma, sujuk, cured meats and Anatolian-Greek small plates with ouzo, tsipouro and wine.
places.background: A meze restaurant and deli built on the cured-meat traditions of the Karamanlides, Anatolian Greek-Orthodox refugees: pastirma, soutzouki and cheeses. Fanis Theodoropoulos continues his family's pastirma trade (1920s), and the restaurant has occupied the corner neoclassical building since 2014.
places.address: Sokratous 1 & Evripidou, Athens 105 52 (deli/pastirma shop at Evripidou 41)

places.name: Linou Soumpasis & Sia (LS & SIA)
places.what_it_is: Hyped modern-Greek 'neo-taverna'/bistro in a former candle shop in Psyrri; dinner-focused, reservations needed, natural-wine list; Michelin Plate 2024-2025. No cocktail menu.
places.background: A restaurant, shop, natural-candle maker and creative office in one bright corner space, opened Dec 2021 by Myrsini (Linou) and George (Soumpasis). It also hosts exhibitions and record launches.

places.name: Cafe Avissinia
places.what_it_is: Old-school Monastiraki flea-market taverna/mezedopoleio on three levels with an Acropolis-view rooftop and live accordion/piano music at weekends; mainly a sit-down meal place.
places.background: Traditional Greek restaurant opened in 1986 by Ketty Koufonikola on the flea-market square; antique-cluttered interior, Acropolis-view terrace, and live folk music at weekends from September to June.

places.name: Wine is Fine
places.what_it_is: French-bistro-style natural wine bar that is effectively a small restaurant: full seasonal food menu, white tablecloths on pedestrian Vissis St; walk-in only, long waitlist.
places.background: Natural-wine bar and restaurant run by two Frenchmen (Rafael Wallon-Brownstone, Thomas Brengou) with Greek chef Stavros Chrysafidis; French-Greek small plates and a low-intervention list. No reservations, 70s-chic interior.

places.name: Booze Cooperativa (K.O.T.E.S.)
places.what_it_is: Multi-level arty bar and cultural space (galleries, performance basement) open from late morning; people come in the day for coffee, chess and backgammon, and it turns into a loud late-night bar with indoor smoking.
places.background: An alternative arts café-bar, founded in 1989 in a neoclassical building, with exhibitions, gigs, talks and a bohemian crowd. Since 2018 it has also been the headquarters of K.O.T.E.S., a tongue-in-cheek 'smokers' party' founded by Nikos Louvros.

places.name: Cantina Social
places.what_it_is: Hidden courtyard/garden dance bar at the end of an alley in Psyrri/Thiseio: cheap drinks, resident DJs (indie to disco), late hours; locals' hangout.
places.background: Unsigned bar at the end of a passage off Leokoriou, set in an old lodge with a garden; a café by day that becomes an alternative-music bar at night (techno to indie), with DJ sets.

places.name: Couleur Locale
places.what_it_is: All-day rooftop bar/bistro in a Monastiraki arcade: coffee and brunch with an Acropolis view by day, DJ cocktail bar at night.
places.background: An all-day rooftop bar opened in 2014 on the top floor of a shabby-looking building by Monastiraki flea market, with a direct Acropolis view. Cocktails, light food and jazz/soul/rock music.

places.name: TAF - The Art Foundation
places.what_it_is: Courtyard café-bar inside an art complex (galleries and a shop) in 1870s buildings. Coffee by day, beers and simple cocktails at night, with an arty young crowd and underground music.
places.background: An art space and café-bar since about 2014 in an 1870s residential complex, with exhibition rooms around a tree-filled courtyard bar. Gallery, shop and drinks in one.

places.name: Retiré (at Ergon House)
places.what_it_is: Seasonal (Apr-Oct) third-floor rooftop cocktail bar with Acropolis view, cocktails by The Clumsies from a cocktail truck; walk-in only, light bites.
places.background: A casual rooftop bar on the terrace of the Ergon House food hall and hotel, with Acropolis views, a cocktail truck and Greek wines and beers.
places.address: Mitropoleos 23 (3rd-floor terrace of Ergon House), Athens 105 57

places.name: Hyper Hypo
places.background: Independent bookstore for art, design, photography, architecture, fashion and pop culture, with a project space for talks, launches and exhibitions; also sells posters and prints.

photos.credit: Photo: hyperhypo.gr

places.name: Plaka
places.background: The oldest quarter, right under the Acropolis: pedestrian lanes, neoclassical houses and the Cycladic-style Anafiotika hamlet. Pretty and very touristy, neither alternative nor posh (tourist-priced tavernas).

photos.credit: Photo: Glorious 93 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: C messier · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: C messier · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Giorgoos · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Dopios
places.what_it_is: Modern Greek meze restaurant (chef Christoforos Peskias) on Agion Theodoron square; a sit-down dinner place with a solid cocktail and wine list.
places.background: A modern Greek meze taverna by chef Christoforos Peskias (since about 2021), focused on small producers from around Greece. It sits under plane trees beside the 11th-century church of Agioi Theodoroi.

photos.credit: Photo: dopiosrestaurant.gr

places.name: The Clumsies
places.what_it_is: World's 50 Best-listed cocktail bar in a townhouse. It is open all day but is mainly a cocktail destination, with a small food menu.
places.background: Cocktail bar founded in 2014 by Vassilis Kyritsis and Nikos Bakoulis, on the World's 50 Best Bars list every year from 2015 and peaking at No. 3 in 2020; open all day across several floors.

places.name: Baba Au Rum
places.what_it_is: Award-winning rum-focused cocktail bar in Psyrri (World's 50 Best Bars #27 in 2025); 400+ rums, tropical/retro decor; no reservations.
places.background: Rum-focused cocktail bar with a 400+ label rum collection, open for over 15 years and a regular on the World's 50 Best Bars list (reported No. 27 in 2025).

places.name: Blue Bird
places.what_it_is: Tiny (23 m2) cocktail bar on pedestrian Ipitou street; spills onto the street at weekends with DJs and a street-party crowd; evening/night only.
places.background: Tiny (about 23 m²) bar on the pedestrian Ipitou street near Syntagma that calls itself a 'bar for exotic birds'; started serving only spirits and now does cocktails, with resident DJs and seating out on the square.

places.name: Dybbuk
places.what_it_is: Large electronic dance club with house and techno nights. Its last known home was the Stadiou 7 arcade, its third location since 2009.
places.background: A house-music club that opened around 2009 in a Kolonaki basement (Patriarchou Ioakeim 37) and later moved to the Stadiou 7 arcade near Syntagma. It was known for big production nights and winter-only seasons.

places.name: Seychelles
places.what_it_is: Modern-Greek sharing-plates restaurant in Metaxourgio/Kerameikos, rustic-meets-urban cooking, outdoor tables on a pedestrian square; mainly a restaurant.
places.background: Yes, the pin is Seychelles (Σεϋχέλλες): an early Athens 'bistronomy' spot serving ingredient-driven Greek 'soul food' on a lively Metaxourgeio square; popular with locals and tourists, booking recommended.

places.name: Beauty Killed the Beast
places.what_it_is: All-day café-bar in a 1930s neoclassical house in Kerameikos: coffee and brunch by day, DJ cocktail bar by night.
places.background: All-day café-bar in a restored 1930s neoclassical mansion on the pedestrian part of Paramythias; brunch by day, DJs and cocktails at night, with a garden and King Kong art on the facade.

places.name: SMUT Athens
places.what_it_is: Queer techno club in an industrial space in Metaxourgeio. Saturday nights, no-photo policy, consent briefing at the door.
places.background: Identified: Vatsaxi 4 is SMUT, an underground queer techno club open on Saturdays. It is known for its safe-space and no-camera policies and a raw, red-lit, Berlin-warehouse look.

places.name: Sodade2
places.what_it_is: Long-running LGBTQ+ dance club in Gazi with two rooms (pop/mainstream and house/progressive); weekends-focused, late.
places.background: One of the first and still most popular gay clubs in Gazi, with two dance floors playing mainstream, house and Greek pop; packed at weekends with a younger crowd.

places.name: S-Cape
places.what_it_is: Two-level mainstream LGBTQ+ dance club in Gazi with pop/Greek music, drag shows, go-go dancers and themed nights; young crowd.
places.background: Long-running large gay club in Gazi with themed nights, drag shows, go-go dancers and several bars and stages; a young crowd and cheap drinks.

places.name: Alekos Fassianos Museum
places.background: The painter Alekos Fassianos's family home, an apartment block he remodelled with architect Kyriakos Krokos over two decades (finished 1996); opened as a museum to his work in 2023.

places.name: Benaki Museum - Pireos 138
places.background: The Benaki's large contemporary venue in a converted industrial building, used for temporary exhibitions of art, architecture and photography.

places.name: The Breeder
places.background: Leading contemporary art gallery founded in 2002 by Stathis Panagoulis and George Vamvakidis, growing out of The Breeder magazine. It is in a converted 1970s ice-cream factory and shows Greek and international artists at major fairs.

places.name: To Rini
places.what_it_is: Tiny chef-run bistro by the Archaeological Museum: coffee and brunch from the morning, Greek comfort-food bistro dishes and natural Greek wines in the evening.
places.background: All-day restaurant near the National Archaeological Museum with modern takes on Greek dishes from seasonal produce and a Greek natural-wine list, with a quiet patio.

places.name: Pharaoh
places.what_it_is: Lively wood-fire Greek restaurant (Michelin Bib Gourmand) with a DJ on vinyl and natural wines, which turns into a party-ish dinner spot late at night.
places.background: Restaurant and natural-wine bar where chef Manolis Papoutsakis cooks Greek dishes without electricity, using wood stoves, charcoal and a wood oven; vinyl DJ in the evenings, behind a heavy curtain in edgy Exarchia.

places.name: I Kriti (Η Κρήτη)
places.what_it_is: Family-run Cretan taverna/rakadiko by Kaningos Sq. (in an arcade/office building), ~30 years running; home-style Cretan dishes with raki and free dessert.
places.background: Family-run Cretan taverna hidden in an arcade (stoa) off Veranzerou, around for nearly three decades and now seen as a classic. It uses produce from Cretan cooperatives: apaki, Sfakian pies, liver with honey.

places.name: Ouzeri Lesvos
places.what_it_is: Unpretentious, old-fashioned Exarchia ouzeri focused on fresh Aegean seafood meze; crowded and mostly local.
places.background: Long-standing Exarchia ouzeri serving seafood and meze from Lesvos or cooked the Lesvos way, at modest prices; a local favourite.

places.name: Zigoala (Ζιγκοάλα)
places.what_it_is: Modern taverna/mageirio in Omonia with Greek and Eastern Mediterranean cooking and laïko music. It was the hyped opening of the 2025–26 season.
places.background: Modern taverna by chef Vasilis Chammam serving meze with Eastern influences; widely reviewed (Athinorama, Lifo, FNL) and credited with drawing food lovers to Omonia.

places.name: Diporto
places.what_it_is: Unmarked basement taverna by the Central Market (since 1887), no menu: daily pot of legumes, small fried fish, salad and barrel wine; lunch only, shared tables, cash.
places.background: Signless basement taverna under an old neoclassical building by the central market. There is no menu: a handful of daily dishes (chickpeas, stews, salad) and retsina from the barrel. Open daytime only.

places.name: Don't be a D!ck
places.what_it_is: Exarchia 'soft clubbing' bar opened autumn 2025: wood-fired 48h-dough pizza and clean cocktails early, then DJ sets (italo/space disco, funk); pink speakeasy 'Toilet Room' downstairs with no-photo policy.
places.background: Fairly new Exarchia bar with a 70s–80s Fiorucci-style look, 48-hour sourdough pizzas from a wood-fired oven, and DJ nights (italo and space disco, funk); its downstairs 'Toilet Room' has pink tiles and a disco ball.

places.name: Skullbar
places.what_it_is: Alternative coffee bar by day that becomes a famous weekend after-hours techno spot (around 05:00–15:00).
places.background: An underground bar and club that is an alternative café by day and a dance club by night. It is best known for weekend after-hours parties (roughly 05:00 to midday) with techno and house.

places.name: National Archaeological Museum
places.background: Greece's largest archaeological museum, with prehistoric to late-antique finds: the Mask of Agamemnon, the Artemision Bronze and the Antikythera Mechanism.

photos.credit: Photo: namuseum.gr
Photo: Gary Todd · CC0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Palickap · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Nikos Kitsakis · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Thomas Wolf, www.foto-tw.de · CC BY-SA 3.0 de · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Ninetto Gallery
places.background: Contemporary gallery co-founded by Romain Bitton and Fred de Schonen in a former apartment, so a visit feels like a collector's home; it shows international and Greece-based artists, often their first exhibitions.

places.name: Romantso
places.background: A creative hub in the former printing works of 'Romantso' magazine. It combines a start-up incubator, artist studios and residencies with a café-bar and a busy programme of exhibitions, parties and concerts.

places.name: Kolonaki
places.background: The upscale district on the lower slopes of Lycabettus, with designer boutiques, galleries, embassies and people-watching cafés around Kolonaki Square (Plateia Filikis Etaireias). The poshest neighbourhood in central Athens: establishment and chic, the opposite of alternative.

photos.credit: Photo: Giorgoos · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Giorgoos · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Andrzej Otrębski · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Filippou (Taverna Filippou)
places.what_it_is: Classic Kolonaki taverna running since 1923, with daily-changing home-cooked (mageirefta) dishes; a lunch/dinner eating place, not a bar.
places.background: A third-generation family taverna founded in 1923 as a basement wine shop, at its current ground-floor site since 1968. It serves classic home-style Greek cooking from an open kitchen.

places.name: Prasini Tenta
places.what_it_is: Café-restaurant on the Lycabettus footpath with a panoramic view. Coffee and brunch by day, cocktails and wine at sunset, and a full Mediterranean food menu.
places.background: Historic café-taverna on the lower slopes of Lycabettus, operating since 1931, with panoramic city views; serves coffee, drinks and Greek and international comfort food.

places.name: Philos Athens
places.what_it_is: Daytime brunch café/restaurant in a 1937 neoclassical house with a concept store; eggs/pancakes/coffee; reportedly will not seat coffee-only customers.
places.background: Café, concept store (fashion, homeware) and event space across three floors of a restored 1930s neoclassical townhouse that once belonged to collector Evripidis Koutlidis; farm-to-table brunch and bowls.

places.name: Dexameni (café-ouzeri)
places.what_it_is: Historic open-air kafeneio on Dexameni square: coffee in the morning, then ouzo/beer with small meze plates through the evening; very local.
places.background: A historic open-air café and meze spot under the trees of Dexameni Square, named after Hadrian's 2nd-century reservoir. It was a haunt of writers like Papadiamantis and Varnalis, and the square also has a summer open-air cinema (Cine Dexameni).

places.name: Queen Bee
places.what_it_is: Kolonaki bakery-café known for sourdough and croissants (a French baker consulted on them), serving all-day brunch.
places.background: All-day bakehouse and brunch spot from Panagiotis Kalyvas (of Capanna and Kolonaki Kalamaki), known for sourdough and croissants such as a pistachio-praline one; busy with stylish Kolonaki locals.

places.name: Rock'n'Roll
places.what_it_is: Kolonaki institution since 1987: American/fusion bar-restaurant (burgers, pizza, tacos) by day, turning into a late DJ/party bar with live acts at night; mixed-age crowd.
places.background: A Kolonaki institution since 1987: a bar-restaurant by day and early evening (pizza, burgers), then a crowded club with DJs and party nights. Its crowd is the smart Kolonaki set.

places.name: Benaki Museum - Nikos Hadjikyriakos-Ghika Gallery
places.background: The former home and studio of modernist painter Nikos Hadjikyriakos-Ghika (1906-94), now a Benaki branch showing his work and that of his circle, with views from the upper floors.

places.name: Benaki Museum (main building)
places.background: The Benaki's flagship mansion, covering Greek art and culture from prehistory to the 20th century; its rooftop café looks over the National Garden.

photos.credit: Photo: Permeniatis Ioannis (1523 - 1528) Details on Google Art Proj · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Marsigli Filippo (1790 - 1863) Details on Google Art Project · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: El Greco · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Dimboukas · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Museum of Cycladic Art
places.background: Museum built around the Goulandris collection of Cycladic figurines and ancient Greek and Cypriot art, also staging major contemporary art shows.

places.name: Byzantine & Christian Museum
places.background: A national museum of Byzantine and post-Byzantine art (icons, mosaics, frescoes, manuscripts) in the 1840s Villa Ilissia, built for the Duchess of Plaisance, with a large modern underground extension and gardens.

photos.credit:
Photo: Χρήστης Templar52

Original uploader was Templar52 at el.wik · Attribution · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: G.dallorto · Attribution · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: G.dallorto · Attribution · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: G.dallorto · Attribution · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Eleftheria Tseliou Gallery
places.background: Contemporary art gallery founded in 2013 that represents about 15 established and emerging, mostly Greek artists, with around seven solo shows a year.

places.name: Indigo (@indigo_ath)
tips: Giulia: her friend Maya runs it. Tell Maya you're Giulia's friend.
places.background: A small lifestyle and gift boutique (Indigo Atelier) selling handmade jewellery, ceramics and macramé. Co-owned by Niki Protopapa and Maya Simou, which matches Giulia's 'friend Maya'.

places.name: Benaki Museum Shop
places.background: Founded about 40 years ago as the first museum shop in Greece, it sells replicas, jewellery, prints, books and pieces by Greek designers. There are five branches across the Benaki buildings plus an online shop.
places.address: Koumbari 1 & Vas. Sofias Ave, Athens 106 74 (main store; also in other Benaki buildings)

places.name: Lycabettus Hill walk
places.background: At 277 m, the highest hill in central Athens, with the chapel of Agios Georgios on top and 360° views over the city to the sea. You can walk up through pines in about 20-30 minutes, or take the funicular from Aristippou St.
places.address: Lycabettus Hill (paths from Kolonaki, e.g. top of Aristippou / Ploutarchou)

photos.credit: Photo: Apaleutos25 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Gosspil89 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Gosspil89 · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Dennis David Auger · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Pangrati
places.background: A residential district behind the Panathenaic Stadium, centred on Plateia Varnava and Plateia Plastira, with a strong local food and bar scene and few tourists. Middle-class and quietly hip: more neighbourhood-bohemian than either alternative or posh.

photos.credit: Photo: George E. Koronaios · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Tolisr · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Badseed · CC BY-SA 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Jebulon · CC0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Cookoovaya
places.what_it_is: Upscale chef-collective modern Greek restaurant near Evangelismos (Michelin-recognised); a dinner destination with a sommelier-led wine list.
places.background: Restaurant opened in 2014 as a collaboration of five Greek chefs (incl. Periklis Koskinas), with an open kitchen, generous Mediterranean dishes and produce from small Greek suppliers; on Michelin and 50 Best Discovery lists.

places.name: Akra
tips: Recommended by both Irene and Giulia.
places.what_it_is: Bistronomy restaurant (Michelin Bib Gourmand) with a wood-fired grill and open kitchen. It runs as a bakery-café for breakfast, with dinner as the main event.
places.background: An all-day restaurant and bakery opened in 2023 by chefs Giannis Loukakis and Spiros Pediaditakis, cooking at a counter and wood-fired grill. It holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand (2024 Athens guide) and is still on Michelin's Greece Bib list.

places.name: Mavro Provato
places.what_it_is: Popular Pangrati mezedopoleio with modern takes on meze and grills; value-for-money neighbourhood favourite (also has a Melissia branch).
places.background: Very popular modern mezedopoleio ('black sheep') in Pangrati serving small plates, home-style dishes and tsipouro at fair prices; reservations recommended.

places.name: Ohh Boy
places.what_it_is: All-day Pangrati bistro/bakery-café for brunch, bowls and cakes with vegan/GF options; also serves spritzes, craft beer and wine early evening.
places.background: An all-day bakery-café and brunch spot with lots of vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options: porridge, protein pancakes, chia bowls and cakes.

places.name: Chelsea Hotel (bar)
places.what_it_is: Bohemian all-day café-bar on Plastira Square: coffee in the day, then a lively, cheap neighbourhood bar with craft beer and simple cocktails at night.
places.background: Not a hotel: a corner café-bar in a former grocery, coffee by day and a busy neighbourhood bar at night. A Pangrati favourite with young locals.

places.name: Thissio
places.background: The area around the pedestrian Apostolou Pavlou promenade, with cafés facing the Acropolis and the Temple of Hephaestus in the Ancient Agora. Relaxed and somewhat touristy but loved by Athenians for evening strolls: mid-range, neither posh nor very alternative.

photos.credit: Photo: Eusebius · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Peter von Hess · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Eusebius · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Bobby H · CC BY-SA 2.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Filopappou Hill (Philopappos)
tips: Irene: the hill just south of Plaka.
Giulia's walk: cross the hill, then go down west into Petralona and eat at Taverna Oikonomou.
places.background: A pine-covered archaeological hill south-west of the Acropolis, topped by the 2nd-century Philopappos Monument and crossed by Pikionis' stone paths. It has the classic Acropolis and sunset view, is free and open, and has a local, unpretentious feel, more green space than scene.

photos.credit: Photo: Eusebius · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: giggel · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Taverna Oikonomou
tips: Giulia's walk: cross Filopappou Hill, go down into Petralona and eat here.
places.what_it_is: Old-school Petralona taverna (since 1930) with home-cooked mageirefta (stuffed veg, rabbit stifado, beans), courtyard/street tables, recited menu.
places.background: An old-school Petralona cook-house, operating since the 1930s by several accounts, serving home-style Greek dishes at a neighbourhood taverna with tables outside.

places.name: Phita (Fita / ΦΙΤΑ)
places.what_it_is: Modern Greek gastro-taverna in Neos Kosmos with a daily-changing, seafood-heavy sharing-plate menu and a curated wine list; dinner-focused.
places.background: A modern Greek 'gastro-taverna' opened in 2019 by Fotis Foteinoglou and Theodoros Kassavetis, with a daily-changing menu of seafood, vegetables and pulses from small producers. It is credited with putting Neos Kosmos on the food map.

places.name: Drupes & Drips
places.what_it_is: Tiny Koukaki hybrid: specialty coffee and juices in the morning, Greek wine, prosecco and raki with cured meats and cheese boards in the evening.
places.background: Coffee in the morning, then an Italian-style spritz and cicchetti bar from midday, with natural/Italian wines and cold cuts.

places.name: Epta Martyres (Seven Martyrs)
places.what_it_is: Neos Kosmos/Koukaki wine bar with Volos-tsipouradiko-style kitchen: 150+ Greek and French low-intervention wines, 10+ by the glass, and €5 small seafood/meze plates sent out as you drink.
places.background: A wine bar that opened in 2024 and quickly became a hangout. It has 200+ Greek and European labels (many magnums), and each glass comes with a small surprise meze, a Volos-style custom.

places.name: Alcatraz (strip club)
places.warning: Recent TripAdvisor reviews describe tourist scams here (e.g. €950 billed for three drinks, June 2025; hostess drinks charged as €150 bottles; taxi drivers steering people in). Agree prices before ordering, or skip it.
places.what_it_is: Strip / 'show club' on Syngrou Ave open 21:00-09:00; repeatedly reported as a tourist trap with taxi-driver steering and inflated bills.
places.background: A strip/show club on Syngrou Avenue, Athens' traditional strip of nightclubs, with reservations by phone or online.

photos.credit: Photo: alcatrazclub.gr

places.name: Benaki Museum of Islamic Art
places.background: The Benaki's Islamic collection (ceramics, metalwork, textiles, carved woodwork from the 7th-19th c.) in two neoclassical mansions. Part of the ancient city wall is visible in the basement, and there is a rooftop café facing Kerameikos.

places.name: Acropolis Museum
places.background: Bernard Tschumi-designed museum (opened 2009) for finds from the Acropolis, including the Parthenon gallery; glass floors show the excavations below.

photos.credit: Photo: Original uploader was Realfacts at el.wikipedia · Attribution · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Nikos Kitsakis · CC BY 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Challisrussia · CC0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Martin451 · CC BY 3.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: National Observatory of Athens - Thissio Visitor Center (evening tour)
tips: Giulia recommends the evening guided visit. Book ahead on noa.gr.
places.background: The historic 1842 observatory on the Hill of the Nymphs runs evening visits with the Geoastrophysics museum, the historic Synge/Doridis telescopes and stargazing (weather permitting).
places.address: Hill of the Nymphs (Lofos Nymfon), Thissio, Athens 118 51

photos.credit: Photo: Panosor · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Dimboukas at English Wikipedia · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Apollo 8 crewmember Bill Anders · Public domain · Wikimedia Commons
Photo: Ggia · CC BY-SA 4.0 · Wikimedia Commons

places.name: Krabo
places.what_it_is: Seasonal beach restaurant and bar at Zoska Bay (Kavouri). Mediterranean lunch under a pergola and sunset cocktails, with paid sunbeds.
places.background: A beach restaurant and bar with sunbeds and cabanas in the small Zoska cove at Kavouri. It serves Mediterranean seafood, pasta and meze with Greek wines.
places.address: Thespidos St, Zoska Bay, Kavouri, Vouliagmeni 166 71

places.name: Island (Island Club & Restaurant / Island Athens Riviera)
places.what_it_is: Upscale seafront summer club-restaurant at Varkiza: sunset dinner then DJ/party until early morning; table/bottle service.
places.background: A long-running seaside restaurant and nightclub on the rocks at Varkiza, with whitewashed 'Cycladic' styling and sea views. It is a glamorous summer night out on the Riviera.
